components_and_sections.name: Sticky Minimal Navbar
components_and_sections.description: Sticky navbar with cream background and thin moss border. Left logo 'Fresh Page' in serif, right links (Story, Reset, About, Contact), active section indicator, LinkedIn/Gmail quick links, mobile dropdown menu, and Reduced Motion toggle.

components_and_sections.name: Wispr Flow x Fresh Page Badge
components_and_sections.description: Two overlapping circles (sage #A8BFA3 for Wispr Flow, clay #D9A88F for Fresh Page) with text 'Speak it, let it go.' in overlap. Plain text labels beside: 'Wispr Flow x Fresh Page'. Reused in Hero, How I Built This, and Footer.

components_and_sections.name: Section 1: Hero & Breathing Circle
components_and_sections.description: Breathing soft sage circle (8s grow/shrink), dynamic visitor local time greeting (Morning/Afternoon/Evening), main headline with clay italic word, subtext, 'Begin my reset' primary button, and privacy note.

components_and_sections.name: Section 2: Why I Built This
components_and_sections.description: Large serif quote about corporate stress and asking for sympathy, followed by Anirudh's personal story of building Fresh Page with Wispr Flow.

components_and_sections.name: Section 3: The 3-Minute Reset Tool
components_and_sections.description: 7-step interactive reset flow: movement picker chips, 4-second breath pause countdown, release textarea with particle upward dissolve effect on 'Let it go', two soft columns ('What's in my hands today' & 'What isn't?'), 6 gentle original affirmations selector, body nudge, and peaceful closing screen.

components_and_sections.name: Section 4: See It In Action
components_and_sections.description: 30-60s screen recording video placeholder with clear dissolve caption.

components_and_sections.name: Section 5: Why Voice Helps
components_and_sections.description: 3 short personal experience cards about voice reflection + Wispr Flow note + disclaimer.

components_and_sections.name: Section 6: The Road to Fresh Page & 12 Small Wins
components_and_sections.description: 3 animated count-up stat cards (2 yrs 10 mos at TCS, 10+ awards, 2 Star of the Month awards), 6-chapter vertical timeline with dashed sage line (Chapter 5 pause card tinted in clay), and 'Meanwhile, in my year off' 12 small wins responsive grid.

components_and_sections.name: Section 7: What I'd Build Next
components_and_sections.description: 3 idea cards tagged 'idea, not built yet' (Sunday night reset, First week at job reset, Manager reset).

components_and_sections.name: Section 8: How I Built This
components_and_sections.description: Voice-first design breakdown, zero storage privacy commitment, built with Wispr Flow & Emergent, large collaboration lockup.

components_and_sections.name: Section 9: Contact
components_and_sections.description: Soft background with 2 floating overlapping background circles, pulsing audio sound-wave bars above headline, plain direct contact buttons for Email (with instant Copy Email address button + toast), LinkedIn, and GitHub.

components_and_sections.name: Section 10: Footer
components_and_sections.description: Collaboration lockup, project statement, and mental health disclaimer support note.

motion_and_reduced_motion.standard_behavior: Gentle entrance fade-in on scroll using Framer Motion, 8-second breathing circle animation, particle dissolve on release, sound-wave bar pulse, floating background circles, count-up numbers.
motion_and_reduced_motion.reduced_motion_mode: When Reduced Motion toggle is ON: replace ALL animations with instant renders or simple fast opacity fades, stop ALL looping motion (breathing circle, particles, drifting circles, sound waves, count-up tickers), and instantly jump scroll instead of smooth scrolling.
motion_and_reduced_motion.toggle_location: Accessible in Navbar with clear status indicator (e.g., 'Reduced Motion: ON/OFF').

accessibility_and_testing.testing_attribute: Every interactive element (button, link, tab, toggle, input, card) MUST include a unique data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid='begin-reset-button', data-testid='reduced-motion-toggle').
accessibility_and_testing.contrast_compliance: Deep moss #3F5A4A on Cream #FAF6EF yields a contrast ratio of >7.5:1, exceeding WCAG AAA standards for legibility.
accessibility_and_testing.focus_states: All focusable elements must have visible focus rings (`focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-[#3F5A4A] focus-visible:outline-none`).

instructions_to_main_agent: Inject Google Fonts link for Fraunces and Karla in public/index.html or index.css.
Configure custom colors in tailwind.config.js for cream (#FAF6EF), sage (#A8BFA3), deep-moss (#3F5A4A), and muted-clay (#D9A88F).
Ensure every main heading contains exactly ONE word wrapped in `<em className="font-serif italic text-[#D9A88F]">`.
Implement the 7-step interactive 3-Minute Reset micro-tool strictly in static React state (no backend, no localStorage persistence, cleared when complete).
Implement the particle dissolve effect on the Release step when clicking 'Let it go'.
Implement the Reduced Motion state toggle cleanly via React Context or state so all animated components respect `reducedMotion` state.
Add explicit data-testid attributes on all interactive elements.
